provenance: Original Peris artwork generated for this project. No third-party game assets copied.
processing: Resize to 384px WebP with alpha, quality 90. Originals preserved.

prompts.low: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single square transparent-background map sprite for Peris, an original fantasy strategy game. Create one compact military mercenary encampment seen from a consistent elevated isometric camera, approximately 40 degrees down. Painterly stylized low-poly forms, muted olive/ochre earth palette, crisp readable silhouette and generous simple shapes that remain legible at 40–80 pixels. Soft daylight from upper left. Fill roughly 85% of a square canvas; leave clear transparent margin. A small irregular earth footprint immediately beneath the camp, no landscape beyond it. True transparent alpha around the entire isolated object. No interface, no letters or numbers, no circular badge or frame, no people, no trees, no houses, no village streets, no domed civic buildings, no palace or castle. A military camp that is visibly different from any player village. No smoke or animated effects. LOW TIER: one large simple tan triangular campaign tent and one much smaller rolled canvas lean-to, a tiny unlit campfire ring, two supply crates, one short plain olive pennant. Open perimeter, no walls. Distinctive low triangular silhouette; rustic mobile outpost.
